title: [spec-gap][R-12-070] Roll call has no multicast initiation; missed check-ins trigger no alerts
description: spec/12-apps.md:1053-1069 (18.6.2): leader initiates roll call via multicast POST coap://[ff02::mesh]/rollcall {id,from,ts,timeout_s}; nodes respond with unicast check-in. spec/12-apps.md:1109 (18.6.4): missed check-ins trigger alerts. Evidence: all three stacks implement only the unicast record model — RollcallResource.render_post accepts direct POST, no multicast destination handling, no leader-response emission, responded/missing populated only by demo update() (emergency.py:414-467; C rollcall lifecycle tests same model; rust client codec only). C /config/checkin tracks due state (checkin.c:1908 lichen_checkin_due) but nothing emits an alert on miss in any stack. Placement: multicast rollcall initiation + response collection; alert emission wired to checkin due state (see 18.4 priority path).
